regime_context: TSX thematic leadership is concentrated in precious metals — Gold Miners lead with the strongest momentum score and highest durability bar; Silver & Royalties follows closely. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control (gate_helps=true), so eligible leaders can be held with drawdown discipline, but cross-sectional rank has no forward alpha and momentum rank is display-only. The rotation is broad (69% eligible) with no single dominant narrative.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Pipelines & Midstream (rank 6, score 0.215, hurst_tag 'trend', uncrowded) improves its durability bar above 0.70 and joins the leadership cluster — if it posts two consecutive weeks of positive relative return against Gold Miners, I would retire this watch and consider it a confirmed rotation candidate.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners show the strongest trend-health (durability_bar 0.79, hurst_tag 'trend') and broad participation (breadth 0.867) among eligible themes, and the absolute-trend gate validates the staying-power leg. The overweight lean is a conditional expression of trend continuation, not a return forecast; crowding is absent so the cautionary size-down flag is not triggered.
theses.dissent: Precious metals leadership is already well-known and the momentum rank-IC is ~0, so further upside may already be discounted; broad macro backdrop is unscheduled-news-heavy (0.92), which can disrupt trend regimes abruptly.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses its 20-day price lead over the S&P/TSX benchmark before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the clear challenger with the second-highest score (1.712), full breadth (1.0), and a solid durability bar (0.76). It shares the precious-metals leadership theme with Gold Miners, making the overweight conditional on continued precious-metals trend. Momentum is a focus lens only; the trend gate supports the stay-power leg.
theses.dissent: Silver & Royalties shares the same proxy as Gold Miners (XGD.TO), so the two leans are not independent; if gold miners roll over, silver/royalties likely follows with higher beta and no idiosyncratic cushion.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO fails to hold positive 20-day return while the S&P/TSX is flat or up before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper ranks third but is crowded (crowding_z 1.12, crowded=true), which is a size-down caution, and has a lower durability bar (0.73) than the precious-metals leaders. The underweight lean reflects a relative de-prioritization among eligible cyclical materials rather than a bearish call; avoid treating crowding as a short signal per guardrails.
evidence: durability_bar 0.73 — lower than Gold and Silver
hurst_tag 'mixed' — weaker trend signature than Gold
theses.dissent: Copper and base metals could benefit from any infrastructure or electrification tailwind not captured in the coincident momentum lens; crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge and should not drive an underweight without trend deterioration.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO outperforms XGD.TO by more than 5% over the check-by horizon

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
